naming_instructions: Format: an optional date, then a short title in Title Case with spaces. Start with the date as YYYY-MM when the content shows one that matters: the invoice or statement date, contract date, meeting date or report period. Use the date from the content, never today's date or a guess; if there is no such date, leave it out. The title is concise, 2 to 5 words: the main subject plus the key company, person or document type. Never use filler words such as document, file, final, copy, version, scan or untitled. Examples: 2026-10 Acme Invoice, 2026-07 Wadi Al Safa Tenancy Contract, Raitio Technical Proposal.
